title: Which loop will you use?
instruction: For each situation in the game, pick the loop that fits.

items.text: The character flashes three times when hit
items.why: You know in advance how many times: three.

items.text: The game runs until the player runs out of lives
items.why: The end depends on what happens, not on the number of rounds.

items.text: The background music plays round and round until you close the game
items.why: Here an endless loop is fine; it’s intentional.
Exactly three steps, known in advance.

items.text: The character falls until it lands on the ground
items.why: How long it falls depends on how high it was.

items.text: Clouds keep slowly drifting across the sky
items.why: Decoration that runs the whole time. It has no reason to end.

debrief: You pick a loop by what you know in advance: an exact count, a condition for the end, or nothing, because the game is meant to keep running.
